name: 32503 · Pensacola, FL
findings: ZIP 32503 (Pensacola) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32503 (Pensacola) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32503 (Pensacola) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 19 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
